A '''Spell of Thought-Touch''' was a [[Dathomir Magic|spell]] that could be cast by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. It allowed a witch to send her thoughts and emotions to another person. Though that person was aware that the thoughts were not their own, they were not aware of the origin of the thoughts.<ref name="CTD" />
